plan.narration_reading: Densified to 16 clips for punch. Open on one man alone (01); 'ends with every nation' on all-nations-blessed (07); 'arms open to every nation' on the worshipping kindreds (08); the verse 'All the ends of the world' on the cross-over-the-world (03); 'all the kindreds shall worship' on Among the Brethren (15); 'one corner of the Roman Empire' on the empire vista (05); 'ends of the earth will turn to God' on a-light-to-the-gentiles (09); 'it sounded impossible' on His Name Is Jesus (19); 'from that cross and the empty tomb' on the empty tomb (10); 'the gospel went out' on The Way Opened From The Dark (17); 'nation after nation turned' on the procession (11); 'worshipping the One who died and rose' on Not Ashamed (16, risen); 'the reach of the cross' on the glowing Christ (18); 'wherever you are' on the lone traveler (12); 'swept the whole earth' on the whole-earth-at-dawn (14); 'room for you to turn to Him' on room-to-turn (13). Hero The Reach of the Cross (04) closes as a held still.
plan.red_team_notes: 16 distinct clips (backfilled from 11 for punch over the long 67.5s read) — ~4s avg. Favored the hopeful 'nations turning to the risen Christ' tone (Among the Brethren, Not Ashamed, the dawn-crosses), avoiding the forsaken-grief faces. Hero 04 not in the assignment; no reuse.
